description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver named MessageReceiver that listens for the 'ACCOUNTS_LISTENER_PACKAGE_INSTALLED' action and logs and displays a toast when a new package is installed.

classes.name: MessageReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for a specific account package installation intent and provides user feedback.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the received broadcast intent, logs the installation event, and shows a toast message.
